Package edu.odu.cs.cs361

Interface BackingStore<E>

All Superinterfaces:
Cloneable, Iterable<TensorEntry<E>>
All Known Implementing Classes:
ArrayBackingStore, HashedBackingStore
public interface BackingStore<E> extends Cloneable, Iterable<TensorEntry<E>>
A multi-dimensional store indexed by a sequence of integers.

  • Method Details

    • getArity

      int getArity()
      Returns:
      the dimension of this store, i.e., the number of indices required to access a value

    • getShape

      int[] getShape()
      Returns:
      the shape of this store, i.e., the width of each index,. The length of the returned array is the arity of the store.

    • get

      E get(int... indices) throws IncorrectArity
      Retrieve a value from the store, given indices as explicit parameters or an an array of int.
      Parameters:
      indices - the indices of the desired value. Can be passed as separate integer values or as an int[] array.
      Returns:
      the value assigned, implicitly or explicitly, to that location
      Throws:
      IncorrectArity - if the number of indices is inappropriate to the tensor
      ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException - if an index is negative or greater or equal to the width of that index in the store.

    • assign

      void assign(E value, int... indices) throws IncorrectArity
      Assign a value to an indexed position.
      Parameters:
      value - value to assign
      indices - position, expressed as a list of int parameters or an int array.
      Throws:
      IncorrectArity - if the number of indices does not match the declaration of the tensor
